batch.title: Batch draw execution
batch.hint: Runs every ready commune's lottery for the selected year, in one action.
batch.selectYearHint: Choose a draw year to enable this.
batch.dialogDescription: Every commune draw shown as ready runs its own independent, atomic lottery, exactly as running it individually would.
batch.validating: Checking which commune draws are ready…
batch.noneReadyBody: No commune draw in this year is both locked and holds a large enough frozen pool.
batch.warningBody: {{count}} commune draws will be run now. Each one excludes its winners from every future draw for life.
batch.partialTitle: Some commune draws failed — see below.

lifecycle.label: Draw progress
lifecycle.cancelledBody: No lottery will run for this commune this year, and this cannot be undone.

pool.validateBody: A dry run. It writes nothing, can be repeated, and reports every problem rather than stopping at the first.
pool.passedTitle: The pool is ready to freeze
pool.passedBody: Every eligible application has a matching frozen weight and the commune has enough entries.
pool.blockedBody: Each problem below must be resolved. Nothing is repaired automatically.
pool.freezeBody: This fixes the terms of the lottery permanently and locks the commune draw. There is no unlock.
pool.confirmFreezeBody: The entries and their weights stop moving from this moment. This cannot be undone by anyone.
pool.selectionBreakdownBody: {{winners}} winners and {{reserves}} reserves — {{total}} selections in one continuous draw. One selected application occupies one position.
pool.frozenBody: These entries are what the lottery will read. Nothing can change them, and there is no unlock.
pool.snapshotHashHint: Identifies the exact input this draw runs on. It is not a seed — the outcome does not depend on it.

execution.readyBody: The pool is frozen and the commune draw is locked. Running the lottery is irreversible.
execution.notLockedBody: The pool must be frozen before the lottery can run.
execution.alreadyRunBody: This draw concluded on {{at}}. A draw runs once, and there is no way to run it again.
execution.nationalOnly: Only a national administrator may run a lottery.
execution.confirmTitle: Run the lottery for this commune?
execution.confirmBody: The server draws the winners and reserves in one transaction. Nothing on this screen affects the outcome.
execution.warningBody: {{winners}} winners and {{reserves}} reserves will be drawn — {{total}} selections in all. One selected application occupies one position, and every selected person is excluded from future draws for life.

result.algorithmHint: The implementation that produced this result. A concluded draw always names its own.
result.winnersHint: The order the lottery drew them in. This list never changes; the status column says what has happened since.
result.reservesHint: Reserves in the order the same draw produced them. A promoted reserve keeps its reserve number.
result.abandonTitle: Record that this winner gave up their place
result.abandonBody: One person records what happened; offering the place to a reserve is a separate decision.
result.abandonWarningTitle: This does not undo the lottery
result.abandonWarningBody: They remain an original winner of this draw, their position in the order is unchanged, and their lifetime Hajj win still stands. Nothing here can reverse that.
result.placeVacant: Place {{order}} is vacant. The next reserve in the order is reserve {{position}}.
result.callTitle: Offer the place to the next reserve?
result.callBody: The order comes from the lottery. Only the next waiting reserve may be called.
result.awaitingAnswer: Reserve {{position}} has been called and has not answered.
result.nothingToDo: No place is waiting on a reserve.
result.acceptBody: They become a Hajj winner. This cannot be undone.
result.acceptConsequenceSingle: This applicant becomes a Hajj winner and is excluded from every future draw for life. Their reserve number does not change.
result.acceptConsequencePaired: This is a paired application: both pilgrims become Hajj winners together and are both excluded from every future draw for life. It cannot be promoted in part.
result.declineBody: The place reopens for the next reserve in the order. This reserve is not asked again.
result.eventsHint: The randomness the draw consumed, one row per selection. Recorded by the server at the moment it ran.
result.unpublishedHint: This result has concluded but has not been announced.
result.publishBody: The result becomes visible to the public. Publication cannot be withdrawn.
result.publishedBody: Citizens can see it on the public results page. There is no way to withdraw a publication.

imports.description: Paper registers, staged for review before anything reaches the ledger.
imports.empty: No import batches match this filter.
imports.stagingBody: The file is parsed into rows for review. Only an approved batch, executed afterwards, changes the participation ledger.
imports.fileHint: CSV or XLSX, up to {{megabytes}} MB. The format is decided by the file's contents, not its name.
imports.checksumHint: Identifies this exact file. Re-uploading it is detected, but every row is still checked again.
imports.importableBody: Nothing blocks it. It still needs approval, and then execution.
imports.blockedBody: Every conflict must be resolved in the source register and the file uploaded again. Nothing is resolved automatically.
imports.approveBody: Approval still writes nothing to the ledger. Executing it afterwards does.
imports.rejectBody: The batch is closed and cannot be reopened. A corrected register may be uploaded as a new batch.
imports.notYourOwn: You uploaded this batch, so somebody else must decide it.
imports.executeBody: Every check runs again first, because a real draw may have concluded since approval.
imports.executeWarningBody: Historical records are written and past winners are excluded from every future draw for life. There is no un-import; a mistake is fixed through the correction workflow.
imports.guideDescription: What the importer requires, read directly from the same rules it checks a register against.
imports.guideHistoricalRuleTitle: Missing is not the same as no
imports.guideHistoricalRule: Missing values will be logged as gaps, not assumed as non-participants.
imports.guideBooleansBody: Accepted as true: {{trueValues}}. Accepted as false: {{falseValues}}. An empty cell is neither — it is recorded as unknown, never assumed.

columns.national_id: Exactly 18 digits. Arabic-Indic digits and separators are folded automatically.

columns.phone_number: An Algerian mobile number, any common way of writing it.

hero.intro: A digital platform for organizing the communal Hajj lottery in Algeria — registration, per-commune weighted draws, and published results, open in Arabic, French and English.

introduction.title: What this platform is
introduction.body: قرعة الحج replaces a paper-based process with a structured, traceable one: citizens register once per year, each commune runs its own weighted draw for its allocated places, and results are published once verified. It is a tool for organizing that process clearly and consistently — not a claim of any government affiliation or official status.

howItWorks.title: How the lottery works
howItWorks.description: From registration to a published result, in six stages.

0.title: Registration
0.body: A citizen submits one application per draw year, alone or paired with one other person, for a specific commune — no account required.

1.title: Eligibility
1.body: Each application is checked against the platform's eligibility rules, such as whether an applicant has already won in a previous year.

2.title: Priority
2.body: An eligible application's weight grows with how many consecutive years it has taken part without winning, so waiting is never wasted.

3.title: Commune draw
3.body: Each commune has its own allocated number of pilgrimage places and runs its own weighted draw once registration for the year closes.

4.title: Winners and reserves
4.body: The draw selects the commune's winners and, in the same draw, an ordered list of reserves for its places.

5.title: Publication
5.body: A national administrator reviews and publishes each commune's result — only then does it become public.

transparency.title: Built for traceability
transparency.description: A few of the properties behind every draw.

0.title: Immutable draw pools
0.body: Once a commune's draw is ready, its list of applications is frozen and can never be altered afterwards.

1.title: Cryptographically secure randomness
1.body: Selection uses the operating system's cryptographically secure random generator — never a predictable or seeded value.

2.title: Weighted, reproducible selection
2.body: Every application's chance is proportional to its recorded weight, through a fixed process applied the same way every time.

3.title: A permanent audit trail
3.body: Administrative actions are recorded — who, when, and why — in a record that can never be edited or deleted.

4.title: The original result stands
4.body: A draw is never rerun or rewritten; later events are recorded alongside the original result, never in place of it.

winnersReserves.title: Winners and reserves
winnersReserves.description: A reserve position is not an additional Hajj place — it is a place in line.

points.0: Winners are selected first, in the order the draw produced.
points.1: Reserves are selected in the same draw, immediately after the winners.
points.2: The reserve order comes from that same draw and is never reshuffled or recalculated.
points.3: If a winner is unable to travel, the next eligible reserve in that order may be called to take their place — the draw itself is never rerun.

languages.body: The whole citizen experience — registration, application status, results and this page — is available in العربية (right-to-left), Français and English.
